    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersPoison Apple tavern applesApple wedges dipped in a hard red candy coatingHow to make it4 apples300g caster sugar100ml water1 tbsp golden syrup1 tsp red food colouringCut the apples into thick wedges and pat very dry.Oil a tray of baking paper.Boil the sugar, water, golden syrup and colouring without stirring until it reaches 150°C.Dip each wedge quickly, letting the extra drip off, and set on the baking paper.Leave to harden.Puss's chorizo and patatas bravasThe cat in boots from SpainHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp fried potato cubes with smoky tomato bravas sauce and garlic aioli, alongside sizzling slices of chorizo finished with honey and parsley.Boil 800g potato cubes for 6 minutes, drain, then roast with oil and salt at 220°C for 30 minutes until crisp.Simmer 1 tin crushed tomatoes with 1 crushed garlic clove, 2 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of chilli for 15 minutes.Mix 120g mayonnaise with 1 grated garlic clove and lemon.Fry 2 sliced chorizo in a dry pan until crisp, then add 1 tbsp honey.Serve the potatoes with both sauces and the chorizo.Manchego and quince pastePuss removes his hat for this one.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsFar Far Away royal roast porkCrackling pork shoulder with roast potatoes and apple sauceHow to make it2kg pork shoulder, skin on1 tbsp sea salt flakes1kg potatoes, peeled and halved2 tbsp olive oil200g apple sauceHeat the oven to 230°C. Score the pork skin and rub well with the salt.Roast the pork at 230°C to start the crackling.Drop the oven to 170°C and keep roasting.Toss the potatoes in oil, add to the tray and roast with the pork.Rest the pork under foil, then carve and serve with the potatoes and apple sauce.Friar's Fat Boy drive-thru burgersThe Fairy Godmother's stop at the Friar's Fat Boy drive-thruHow to make itAs written, serves 4Double beef burgers with cheese, bacon, onion rings and a smoky sauce in soft buns, with shoestring fries, the way a fairytale drive-thru would do it.Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls.Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp barbecue sauce.Fry 8 rashers of bacon until crisp.Bake 800g frozen shoestring fries and 300g frozen onion rings at 220°C for 20 minutes.Smash the balls thin on a smoking hot pan, salt and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute.Toast 4 buns and stack 2 patties, bacon, onion rings and sauce in each.SweetsGiant gingerbread manSpiced gingerbread cookie cut in one giant man shapeHow to make it125g butter100g brown sugar120ml golden syrup375g plain flour2 tsp ground ginger1 pinch of ground cinnamon1 tsp bicarbonate of soda200g icing sugar1 bag of gumdropsMelt the butter, brown sugar and golden syrup together and let cool a little.Stir in the flour, ginger, cinnamon and bicarbonate of soda to make a dough.Wrap and chill the dough for an hour.Heat the oven to 180°C. Roll out and cut one huge gingerbread man and lots of small ones.Bake the small ones first, then the big one, until firm at the edges.Cool, mix the icing sugar with a little water, pipe on and add gumdrop buttons.Muffin Man's muffinsButtermilk muffins full of blueberriesHow to make it300g plain flour, for the muffins150g caster sugar2 tsp baking powder250ml buttermilk100g butter, melted1 egg200g blueberries50g plain flour, for the crumble40g cold butter, for the crumble30g brown sugar, for the crumbleHeat the oven to 200°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin.Rub the crumble flour, cold butter and brown sugar together into rough crumbs.Mix the flour, sugar and baking powder in a large bowl.Whisk the buttermilk, melted butter and egg, tip into the dry mix and stir only until just combined.Fold in the blueberries, spoon into the tin and scatter with crumble.Bake until risen and golden.DrinksFairy Godmother's blue lemonadewith blue raspberry cordial and edible glitterHow to make it1 L cold lemonade100ml blue raspberry cordial1 pinch of edible glitterPour the lemonade into small bottles or tall glasses.Add a splash of cordial to each and stir gently.Drop in a pinch of glitter, give one more swirl and serve straight away.
